name: Kankin Shiiku Hotel
source:
"ROYAL APPLAUSE" is a luxurious VIP hotel where top politicians and idols gather. But under the beautiful facade hotel owner confines and enslaves famous women there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
“皇家掌声”是一家豪华VIP酒店，顶级政客与偶像明星云集于此。然而，在光鲜外表之下，酒店老板却将知名女性囚禁在那里，强迫她们成为奴隶。
